mapper.select: /* 업체별 마진율 조회 */ SELECT margin_ratio_no AS marginRatioNum , ent_ceo_no AS EnterpriseCeoNum , ent_emp_id AS EnterpriseEmployeeId , period AS period , margin_ratio AS marginRatio , register_date AS registerDate , revision_date AS revisionDate, use_status AS useStatus FROM margin_ratio WHERE ent_ceo_no = 'ent_ceo_2' ORDER BY period DESC;
